fault_mode: Reset during an RDMA reconnect can leave controller initialization waiting forever for an outstanding admin property request.
trigger: Start controller reset, flap the RDMA link during reconnect/initialization, and repeat around the timing window.
observation: Reset does not return; controller remains in an intermediate initialization state with an outstanding admin request.
recovery: A reset must either reconnect and finish or fail with a bounded error; verify later I/O and repeated resets remain usable.
